Want to express yourself better and speak more fluently? Want to talk about yourself in an engaging way? This is it. Meet Luna.

Pobranie jest darmowe. Plan Darmowy działa bez konta (z dziennym limitem), Podstawowa – za darmo z kontem. Premium i Pro to jednorazowy dostęp na 30 dni, bez odnawiania, z VAT. Wyższy plan zawiera niższe. Płatności online – wkrótce.

Free to download. The Free plan works without an account (daily limit), Basic is free with an account. Premium and Pro are one-off 30-day passes, no renewal, VAT included. Each higher plan includes the lower ones. Online payments – coming soon.

Licznik nie kłamie – zgłoś się!
